title: Simulation 3D Spacecraft
text: Implement spacecraft in 3D environment, 3 inputs, {Initial rotation (rad)} sets Initial rotation of spacecraft; {Type} sets the spacecraft type, {Path to CubeSat mesh}, {Path to SmallSat mesh}, {Name} sets the spacecraft name, {Initial translation (m)} sets the initial translation of spacecraft zeros, {Scale source}, {Initial scale} sets the initial mesh scale, {Scale} sets the mesh scale and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Path to CubeSat mesh
params.values: Path to CubeSat mesh /MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Spacecraft/CubeSat/Mesh/SK_CubeSat.SK_CubeSat (default) | character vector

params.name: Path to SmallSat mesh
params.values: Path to SmallSat mesh /MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Spacecraft/SmallSat/Mesh/SK_SmallSat.SK_SmallSat (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial translation (m)
params.values: Initial translation of spacecraft zeros(10,3) (default) | 10-by-3 array | 20-by-3 array

params.name: Initial rotation (rad)
params.values: Initial rotation of spacecraft zeros(10,3) (default) | 10-by-3 array | 20-by-3 array
